Name: Truffle and Doors Auto-Grabber for 1.6
Author: AstralFSK
Description:
I was returning to Stardew from Zomboid after 2 yrs, and noticed that theres no *stable* mod that make Auto-Grabber grab truffle, so here we are !
If Auto-Grabber can already automatically harvests milk from cows and goats, wool from sheep and Ostrich Eggs from Ostriches* (totally not copied from stardew wiki), then why not truffles also ?

However due to various limitations, you'll have to find out which auto-grabber on your farm grabs the truffles, but as long as you don't move it, that grabber will always be the chosen one. All the truffles existing on ground will be grabbed by said grabber when player enter the farm next time.

The grabbed truffles' quality will also be affected by pet's hearts and Gatherer/Botanist profession.
Version 1.1 allows auto-grabbers to close and open barns/coops door automatically. This can be disabled in mod config menu.

Now also supports auto grabber placed on farm, if this option is turned on, that auto grabber (if exist) will grab truffle instead.

Walk Of Life - Profession Overhaul is supported.

Downloads.Description:
- Support auto grabber placed on farm, if this option is turned on, that auto grabber will grab truffle instead.
- Fix a bug that make mod config not appear.
